proof_0314.moves: Show the topology-replaced pseudometric structure equals the original by extensionality for pseudometric spaces: the distance function is literally unchanged, so pointwise equality (funext / rfl) finishes. The real content is that PseudoMetricSpace is determined by its dist.

proof_0315.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the bundled ring hom that sends a vector to its diagonal matrix is defined by that very formula, so applying its coercion reduces to the underlying function and the goal closes by rfl. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0316.moves: Definitional: pushing a function through a constant simple function gives the constant at the image point, and both sides unfold to the same term, so rfl. The content is that map is defined by postcomposition and const by a constant function.

proof_0317.moves: Evaluation aeval x is an algebra homomorphism, and algebra homs preserve the multiplicative unit; so the whole proof is one application of map_one. Everything else is instance plumbing for the semiring/algebra structures.

proof_0318.moves: Auto-generated reassociated form of functorMap_comp: take the existing composition identity and whisker it on the right by an arbitrary further morphism, reassociating with the category associativity law. No new mathematics beyond the original lemma.

proof_0319.moves: A simp-normal-form lemma recording what the spectral object functor does on an object; the defining data is exactly the stated expression, so it closes by rfl. Pure unfolding of a definition wrapped in heavy triangulated-category instance context.

proof_0320.moves: The pointwise subtraction of finsets is by definition the binary image under vsub, so nonemptiness of the result forces nonemptiness of the right factor by the general image2 lemma. One transport of a general statement through a definitional identification.

proof_0321.moves: Pointwise vadd of finsets is the binary image under vadd, and the binary image of two singletons is the singleton of the value; so the statement is the image2 singleton lemma read through that definition.

proof_0325.moves: Membership in the doubly stochastic submonoid is by construction the stated conjunction of nonnegativity and unit row/column sums, so the iff holds definitionally (Iff.rfl). Pure unfolding of a SetLike definition.

proof_0326.moves: Compute the cardinality of the powerset of the naturals: the cardinality of a set-of-X is 2^#X, then #N = aleph0, and 2^aleph0 is by definition the continuum. Chain of two rewrites closed by the definition of continuum.

proof_0330.moves: The homeomorphism built from an equivalence that is inducing carries that same underlying equivalence by construction, so the projection back gives it verbatim and the goal is rfl.

proof_0332.moves: Extended nonnegative reals are WithTop of the nonnegative reals, so the cancellation-under-addition statement follows from the general WithTop lemma once the nonnegative reals are known to be an additive cancellative commutative monoid; the finiteness hypothesis is what makes it work.
